The Site Lessor and the Institution hereby agree that the Lease is herebyterminated and cancelled as of the date hereof. Section 2.No Assignment of Site Lessor_Agreement.  The parties hereto hereby represent that their respective rights under the Lease have not been assigned. Section 3.Counterparts. This Agreement may be simultaneously executed in several counterparts, each of which shall be an original and all of which shall constitute but one and thesameinstrument. Section 4. Miscellaneous. (a)   This Agreement shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, thelawsoftheStateofNewYork. (b) The Institution and the Site Lessor, agree that this Agreement shall be recorded by the Institution in the appropriate Office of the Register of The City of NewYork. 503520.1 029015 TERM
